intro: Farren's Proof is a short delivery mission in Southshore where an adventurer carries a grisly bounty of murloc heads from Lieutenant Farren Orinelle to Marshal Redpath. Having let someone else do the bloody work of hunting the coast, the squeamish lieutenant delegates the actual reporting as well. It marks an intermediate step in securing town recognition along the Hillsbrad coast.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You know, friend, I'd really rather not take these heads...
Since you've already got a handle on them, would you mind delivering them to Redpath for me?

clips.title: Progress
paras: Greetings, citizen. Have you come to lend your arm to upholding the safety of Southshore?

clips.title: Completion
paras: If you assisted Farren in procuring these heads, then thank you. Southshore needs hard workers and effort to maintain its protection.
